title: A declared language that is wrong: language_mismatch
about: d-01 is declared en but written in Arabic. d-02 is declared ar but written in English. d-03 is correct.

pages:
نشرة معلومات للمريض

أقراص لورفانتين 250 ملغ المغلفة

اقرأ هذه النشرة بعناية قبل البدء في تناول الدواء لأنها تحتوي على معلومات مهمة لك.

1. ما هو هذا الدواء وما هي دواعي استعماله

يستعمل هذا الدواء مرة واحدة في اليوم كما أوصاك الطبيب. يحتوي كل قرص على 250 ملغ من المادة الفعالة.

5. كيفية تخزين هذا الدواء

يحفظ بعيداً عن متناول الأطفال. لا يحفظ في درجة حرارة تزيد عن 25 درجة مئوية.

Summary of Product Characteristics (draft, sections 1 to 6)

1. Name of the medicinal product

Lorvantine 250 mg film-coated tablets

2. Qualitative and quantitative composition

Each film-coated tablet contains 250 mg of lorvantine hydrochloride.

3. Pharmaceutical form

Film-coated tablet. White, oval, biconvex tablets.

6.3 Shelf life

The shelf life of the medicinal product is 36 months.

6.4 Special precautions for storage

Do not store above 25 C.

6.5 Nature and contents of container

PVC/PVDC-Alu blisters in cartons of 30 tablets.

Stability report: Lorvantine 250 mg film-coated tablets

Contents

3.2.P.8.1 Stability summary and conclusion ........ page 2
3.2.P.8.3 Stability data ........ page 3

3.2.P.8.1 Stability summary and conclusion

Three primary batches of Lorvantine 250 mg film-coated tablets were placed on stability in the proposed commercial pack. All results stayed within specification at every time point. Based on these data, a shelf life of 36 months is proposed when the product is stored below 25 C in the original package.

3.2.P.8.3 Stability data

The long-term study was stored at 25 C / 60% RH for 12 months.
